title: pyrus lanceolata
intro: Pyrus lanceolata, commonly known as Chinese Pear, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. The health benefits of Pyrus lanceolata include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and lower cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus lanceolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
